_comment: The car domain's criteria — decisions 5–11 of docs/plans/archive/scout-rename-and-car-domain.plan.md. ONE hard ceiling (the displayed price), a geography filter that acts only on a STATED location, and score components for everything else. A gitignored criteria.local.json beside this file overrides field by field. Unknown keys are refused.
_max_price_eur: Decision 5: 0–30 000 € on the DISPLAYED price — wide on purpose, the score discriminates.
_postcode_prefixes: Decision 6, revisited. EMPTY = national, and that is the honest state rather than a widening (Track 1c). It was the eight Île-de-France departements, copied from the rent side — and it was INERT: no car source maps a postcode at all, so `matchesLocation()` was answering true for every vehicle regardless. Leaving the list in place meant the filter would activate silently and asymmetrically the day a source first mapped one, on criteria nobody had reconsidered for cars. A car is driven to you; the geography that matters is the seller's, and no source publishes it yet. Reversed by restoring the eight prefixes in this one line.
_body_rank: Decision 11: a RANK, the commune_rank mechanism — ranked bodies score by position, an unranked one scores 0 and is still notified.
_peak_age_years: Decision 7: ≤ 5 years and ≤ 80 000 km are SCORE PEAKS, never disqualifiers; the portal saved searches are set wider (7 y / 100 000 km) so near-misses arrive and are ranked.
_weights: Sum to 100. price: lower is better, linear from the ceiling. age/mileage: full marks up to the peak, 0 at twice it. gearbox: automatic (decision 11). fuel: petrol/hybrid/electric over diesel — a PREFERENCE, never a ZFE claim. body: by rank. brand: an INVERTED rank — see _brand_avoid. REBALANCE: brand's 10 points are taken from price (25→20) and body (15→10), so the total stays 100 and `high_priority_score` keeps meaning what it meant. That allocation is a DEFAULT APPLIED (2026-08-31), not a developer ruling: what was ruled is only that the brand weight comes OUT of the existing 100 rather than pushing past it. Reversed by taking the 10 from different components in this one line.
_brand_avoid: Developer ruling 2026-08-31: a PENALTY, not a preference ranking. Deliberately NOT named `brand_rank` — body_rank's mechanism scores its TOP entry highest, which here would reward exactly the makes being avoided. An unlisted make earns the whole `brand` weight; a listed one earns none; no ordering among the listed ones was ruled, so they are equal. A make that could not be extracted earns the full share too (hard rule 9: unknown is not disfavoured) — as does every make when this list is empty, which keeps the achievable maximum at 100 for a deployment that configures no preference. Folded at load, so the config may write `Peugeot` and a payload `PEUGEOT`.
_why: brand_avoid, two things about it. FIRST, EACH ENTRY IS A STEM, matched to a non-letter boundary — never an exact string. Measured 2026-09-01: the live store holds the same marque as `ds` (leboncoin) and `ds automobiles` (autohero), and exact equality caught one and silently missed the other. So write the SHORTEST unambiguous form — `alfa`, not `alfa romeo`; `fiat` also covers `fiat professional` — because the gap runs both ways and a stem longer than the make misses just as quietly. SECOND, the 22 ruled 2026-09-01 are NOT 'Stellantis' — do not tidy the list into one. Stellantis contributes 14 marques (peugeot citroen ds opel vauxhall fiat abarth lancia alfa jeep dodge chrysler ram maserati); ford and chevrolet are the developer's own additions and belong to neither group; renault, dacia, nissan, alpine and mitsubishi are the Renault-Nissan-Mitsubishi alliance, in because they share Renault mechanicals (Dacia is a rebadge, the Nissan 1.2 DIG-T is the Renault H5Ft, the European Colt is a Clio); leapmotor is Stellantis-distributed rather than a Stellantis marque. Reversed make by make in the one line below.
_exclude_patterns: Extra exclusions over the folded text, beside the non-configurable §1 vehicle set in VehicleClassifier. Empty on purpose: the ParuVendu alert is already 'Voiture d'occasion'.

notify._channels: Same channel names as the rent side; built by the same factory, with the [car-watch] prefix.
notify._high_priority_score: CALIBRATED 2026-08-31 against the store rather than guessed, which is what the rent side's own 70 was not. RE-MEASURED 2026-09-01 after brand_avoid went from 3 makes to 22, by re-judging all 160 stored snapshots through the real scorer (reference 2026-09): min 0, median 62, p90 75, max 83 — 49 clear 70, so the threshold stays REACHABLE and the car verdict carries no confidence floor to make it unreachable by construction. THE WIDER LIST DISCRIMINATES MORE, NOT LESS, which is the opposite of what was predicted before it was run: avoided makes now score a median of 58 against 71 for unlisted — 13 points of separation against the 9 the previous three managed (60 vs 69) — with 11 of 94 clearing 70 against 38 of 66. Left at 70: every row in the sample is a MATCH (nothing in it was ever rejected), so the sample still cannot say what a tighter bar would cost. Revisit with a week of real rejections in view.
notify._source_alert_cooldown_hours: One alert per (source, status) per cooldown — the rent side's rule, same default.
